note: The composites @automattic/vip-admin-ui ships, as realizations of Loupe's pattern language. Merged over the WPDS profile's registry, winning on key. Point a plugin's loupe.config.json at this file with "patterns": "node_modules/@automattic/vip-admin-ui/patterns.json" (relative to the plugin's repo root).

instead_of: A Stack of Buttons with hand-set alignment
Buttons spaced with margin, or pushed apart with margin-left: auto
realizations.note: Every group of actions: cancel first, primary last, right-aligned. `stretch` for containers too narrow to hug. See docs/actions.md.

instead_of: A Modal with a hand-built footer Stack and per-modal footer CSS
Per-child margins inside a modal body instead of ModalBody's gap
realizations.note: A @wordpress/components Modal whose content is wrapped in ModalBody and whose footer is ModalActions. See docs/modals.md.

instead_of: A hand-built Modal + Text + button pair asking yes or no
realizations.note: `const [ confirm, confirmDialog ] = useConfirm();` then `await confirm( message, options )`. For yes/no only; an informational dialog is a Modal with one Close in ModalActions.

instead_of: A one-off side panel with a bespoke header and its own section dividers
realizations.note: InspectorShell holding InspectorSections in a Stack gap="lg", read-outs as Fact rows, lists as InspectorFieldList, and at most one InspectorDangerZone at the foot. See docs/inspector.md.

instead_of: A bare <ReactFlow> with hand-built node and edge components per plugin
Edges left to React Flow's own paths, so each one is routed without knowing where the others go
React Flow's reconnect anchors, which sit on the handle an edge nominally uses rather than where the line ends
realizations.note: A node/edge canvas: cards, routed edges, bands, and the right-click menu. Detected by its import rather than by shape — React Flow is not a design-system package, so there is no signature to match. The plugin keeps its model, its layout and every "can this connect to that" answer; what the card shows is node data. See docs/graph.md.

nodes.note: A card is `type: GRAPH_NODE_TYPE` and its state is node data: label, meta, badge, warnings, accent, and named exits. Nothing is styled per plugin.

edges.note: Plain React Flow edges; the canvas defaults their type and plans every one of them together. `data.label` is the pill, `data.linkLabel` the mark a set of edges standing on one record wears.

bands.note: `bands`: a line across the whole pane and a label pinned to the viewport's left edge. Which band a point is in, and what landing there means, stays with the plugin's layout.

canvas-actions.note: `contextMenu` returns the verbs for whatever was right-clicked — pane, node, edge or band — and `onResetLayout` adds the reset button to the zoom controls.
